item.title: Legendary Coach Gary Rankin Resigns at Boyd Buchanan
item.description: (press release) Boyd-Buchanan School announced Wednesday that Gary Rankin has resigned as head football coach, concluding a highly successful and historic tenure leading the Buccaneers. As a member of the National High School Hall of Fame, Rankin departs the program with 510 career victories, cementing his legacy as one of the most accomplished coaches in high school football history. item.title: Term Limits resolution for Hamilton County mayor, commissioners, introduced
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. (WDEF)- A resolution that would create a referendum on term limits in Hamilton County government was formally introduced Wednesday. If passed, voters would get to choose whether or not both the Hamilton County Mayor and commissioners would be term limited to 12 years. item.title: ETSU Defeats Chattanooga 73-61
item.description: JOHNSON CITY, Tenn. (AP) — Jordan McCullum had 24 points in East Tennessee State’s 73-61 victory over Chattanooga on Wednesday. Chattanooga had won the last five meetings against the Bucs in Johnson City. McCullum also had six rebounds for the Buccaneers (19-7, 11-2 Southern Conference). item.description: East Ridge, TN-(WDEF-TV) The East Ridge basketball team has managed to produce a winning record so far this season, which is pretty remarkable, considering over half of their roster is made up of freshmen. Brian Armstrong reports. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
